statement: From the point $P(5,1)$, tangents are drawn to the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}=9$. Find the length of each tangent from $P$ to the circle.
solution: The circle has centre $O(0,0)$ and radius $3$. The distance $OP=\sqrt{5^{2}+1^{2}}=\sqrt{26}$. The tangent length from $P$ is $\sqrt{OP^{2}-r^{2}}=\sqrt{26-9}=\sqrt{17}$.
hints: Find the centre and radius of the circle.
